blocks.tex:
The contacts $B,C$ are distinct by simplicity, so
$\theta_C>\theta_B$. Choose a small counterclockwise step
$D=z(\theta_B+\delta)$, with $0<\delta<\pi$ and
$\theta_B+\delta<\theta_A$. Because the incoming vertex is strictly
inside the disk, the one-sided circle-step calculation places $D$
strictly to the left of the incoming line. Make $\delta$ small enough
that $D$ is in the clearance ball from \ref{mf:contact-clearance}.
Choose $X$ sufficiently close to $B$ in the outgoing open edge; its side
sign is positive because the original contact turn is positive.

The detour $D,X,v_1,\ldots,C$ and return chain $A,\ldots,B$ are disjoint
by \ref{mf:contact-detour}, and convexity keeps them in the disk.
If $\theta_C=\theta_A$, they already meet at that endpoint. If
$\theta_C>\theta_A$, their four circle endpoints have order
$\theta_B+\delta<\theta_A<\theta_C<\theta_B+2\pi$, alternating between
the two paths. The disk-crossing theorem gives a contradiction.

blocks.label: mf:contact-complement-coordinates
blocks.title: Contact coordinates on the complementary polygonal arc
blocks.body:
For a selected run, let $d=c+b+1$ and $m=n-(b+1)+(a-1)$.
Then $m<n$, $d+m=c+a-1$ modulo $n$, and every contact has a coordinate
$d+t$ with $0\le t\le m$. If there are at least three contacts, one has
such a coordinate with $0<t<m$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.complementContactArcLength_lt
lean.code:
theorem complementContactArcLength_lt :
    run.complementContactArcLength < n := by
  have hb := run.b_lt
  have ha := run.a_pos
  have hab := run.a_le_b
  have hU : run.b + 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hLU : run.chainStart < run.b + 1 := by
    simp only [chainStart]
    omega
  simp only [complementContactArcLength]
  omega

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.exists_strict_complementContactArcCoordinate
lean.code:
theorem exists_strict_complementContactArcCoordinate
    (hcard : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card) :
    ∃ (i : ZMod n) (t : ℕ),
      OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i ∧
      0 < t ∧ t < run.complementContactArcLength ∧
      Gluck.cyclicLift (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1)) t = i := by
  classical
  let A : ZMod n := Gluck.cyclicLift run.c run.chainStart
  let B : ZMod n := Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1)
  have hex : ∃ i ∈ circleContactSet v O R, i ≠ A ∧ i ≠ B := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    have hsub : circleContactSet v O R ⊆ {A, B} := by
      intro i hi
      by_cases hiA : i = A
      · simp [hiA]
      · have hiB := hnone i hi hiA
        simp [hiB]
    have hle : (circleContactSet v O R).card ≤ 2 := by
      calc
        (circleContactSet v O R).card ≤ ({A, B} : Finset (ZMod n)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ ≤ 2 := Finset.card_le_two
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, hiE, hiA, hiB⟩ := hex
  have hi : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hiE)
  obtain ⟨t, htm, htEq⟩ := run.exists_complementContactArcCoordinate_aux hi
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro ht
    subst t
    apply hiB
    simpa [B, Gluck.cyclicLift] using htEq.symm
  have htm' : t < run.complementContactArcLength := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne htm
    intro ht
    have hArc := run.cyclicLift_right_add_complementContactArcLength
    apply hiA
    dsimp [A, B] at hArc ⊢
    rw [← htEq, ht]
    exact hArc
  exact ⟨i, t, hi, ht0, htm', htEq⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.cyclicLift_right_add_complementContactArcLength
lean.code:
theorem cyclicLift_right_add_complementContactArcLength :
    Gluck.cyclicLift (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1))
        run.complementContactArcLength =
      Gluck.cyclicLift run.c run.chainStart := by
  have hb := run.b_lt
  have hU : run.b + 1 ≤ n := by omega
  dsimp [complementContactArcLength, Gluck.cyclicLift]
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hU]
  rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.complementContactArcLength
lean.code:
def complementContactArcLength : ℕ :=
  n - (run.b + 1) + run.chainStart

blocks.tex:
The complementary polygonal arc goes from $B$ to $A$ through the closing
index, so the two lengths $n-(b+1)$ and $a-1$ add to $m$. The inequalities
$0<a\le b<n$ give $m<n$. All omitted labels are internal labels of the
noncontact run, so every contact is on this complement. The half-open
one-period coordinates are injective. With at least three contacts one
can choose a label different from the two endpoint labels, giving the
strict inequalities for its coordinate.

blocks.label: mf:contact-coverage
blocks.title: One ordered third contact controls all contacts
blocks.body:
Let a selected run belong to a simple polygon with a positive-radius
minimal disk. Suppose an intermediate complementary contact at coordinate
$0<p<m$ has angles
\[
 B=z(\theta_B),\quad C=z(\theta_C),\quad A=z(\theta_A),\qquad
 \theta_B<\theta_C<\theta_A<\theta_B+2\pi.
\]
Then every contact has an angular representative in
$[\theta_B,\theta_A]$, and consequently
$\pi\le\theta_A-\theta_B<2\pi$. These angles provide the complementary
circle-arc certificate.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.circleArcCertificateOfOrderedComplementContact
lean.code:
noncomputable def circleArcCertificateOfOrderedComplementContact
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R)
    (hR : 0 < R)
    {p : ℕ} {θB θC θA : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpm : p < run.complementContactArcLength)
    (hB : run.point (run.b + 1) = circlePoint O R θB)
    (hC : v (Gluck.cyclicLift
      (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1)) p) = circlePoint O R θC)
    (hA : run.point run.chainStart = circlePoint O R θA)
    (hBC : θB < θC) (hCA : θC < θA)
    (hspan : θA < θB + 2 * Real.pi) :
    Section4CircleArcCertificate run := by
  apply run.circleArcCertificate_of_contactCoverage hΔ hR hB hA
    (hBC.trans hCA) hspan
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨t, htm, htEq⟩ := run.exists_complementContactArcCoordinate_aux hi
  have hidist : dist O (v i) = R := by
    simpa [dist_comm] using Metric.mem_sphere'.mp hi
  obtain ⟨θD, hθDwin, hiD⟩ :=
    exists_circlePoint_eq_mem_angleWindow hidist θB
  have hB' : v (Gluck.cyclicLift
      (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1)) 0) = circlePoint O R θB := by
    simpa [point, Gluck.cyclicLift] using hB
  have hA' : v (Gluck.cyclicLift
      (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1))
        run.complementContactArcLength) = circlePoint O R θA := by
    rw [run.cyclicLift_right_add_complementContactArcLength]
    simpa [point] using hA
  have hD' : v (Gluck.cyclicLift
      (Gluck.cyclicLift run.c (run.b + 1)) t) = circlePoint O R θD := by
    rw [htEq]
    exact hiD
  have hθDA : θD ≤ θA :=
    circlePoint_angle_le_endpoint_of_ordered_anchor_aux
      hsimple (fun z ↦ Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hΔ.2.1 z)) hR hp hpm
      run.complementContactArcLength_lt htm
      hB' hC hA' hD' hBC hCA hspan hθDwin
  exact ⟨θD, ⟨hθDwin.1, hθDA⟩, hiD⟩

deps.title: Separated polygonal chains cannot have alternating contacts
deps.label: mf:contact-order-crosscut

blocks.tex:
Represent another contact $D$ at complementary coordinate $t\in[0,m]$
and angle $\theta_D\in[\theta_B,\theta_B+2\pi)$.
If $\theta_D>\theta_A$, its label cannot be an endpoint or $p$.
When $0<t<p$, the polygon order $B,D,C,A$ and circle order $B,C,A,D$
force separated subchains to cross. When $p<t<m$, use polygon order
$B,C,D,A$ and the same circle order. Both contradict
\ref{mf:contact-order-crosscut}, with a cyclic shift when needed to put
the four labels in natural order. Thus $\theta_D\le\theta_A$ for every
contact. The semicircle bound of \ref{mf:contact-semicircle} now supplies
the missing lower bound on the span. This derives contact coverage
before using minimality to bound the angular length.

blocks.body:
For a selected positive chain in a simple polygon with a minimal disk of
radius $R>0$, if $|E|\ge3$, a complementary circle-arc certificate exists.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.Section4PositiveRunCertificate.nonempty_circleArcCertificate_of_three_contacts
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_circleArcCertificate_of_three_contacts
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R)
    (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcard : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card) :
    Nonempty (Section4CircleArcCertificate run) := by
  obtain ⟨θB, θA, hB, hA, hBA, hspan⟩ :=
    run.exists_ordered_endpointAngles_of_minimalDisk hsimple hΔ
  obtain ⟨i, p, hi, hp, hpm, hpEq⟩ := run.exists_strict_complementContactArcCoordinate hcard
  obtain ⟨θC, hC, hBC, hCA⟩ :=
    run.exists_ordered_complement_contact_angle_aux hsimple hΔ hR hB hA hBA hi hp hpm hpEq
  exact ⟨run.circleArcCertificateOfOrderedComplementContact hsimple hΔ hR hp hpm hB
    (by rw [hpEq]; exact hC) hA hBC hCA hspan⟩

blocks.tex:
The two distinct endpoint labels exhaust the contact set, so
\ref{mf:contact-diameter} applies. The chord-length identity gives
\[
 2R=|z(\theta_A)-z(\theta_B)|
    =2R\sin\bigl((\theta_A-\theta_B)/2\bigr),
\]
where $0<\theta_A-\theta_B<2\pi$. The half-angle belongs to $(0,\pi)$;
its sine is one only at $\pi/2$. Thus the span is exactly $\pi$.
